items.title: Joe Wilder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: . . . Maurice André, and the Russian [Timofei] Dokshizer, and then along comes Wynton Marsalis.

ctx.x: . . . Maurice André, and the Russian [Timofei] Dokshizer, and then along comes Wynton Marsalis. They’re all topnotch players. I listen to them, and I say, I wonder why I even picked up the instrument? When you hear the things they do, and the way in which they do it – now Wynton, being the younger of the three, he does the things that they have done in the past as well and in many instances even better than they. It’s just the way life is. I have a tremendous respect and appreciation for everything they do. It’s…
What do you find yourself listening to now? When you go home and turn on the radio or turn on a record or CD, what do you listen to?
